footer.tagline: Local inventory, online. See what the shops around you have in stock, then reserve it or get it delivered by the shop.
footer.notice: Map data from OpenStreetMap contributors. Demo data: shops, prices and sales are generated for demonstration.

searchBox.placeholder: Search for a product, brand or need
searchBox.label: Search products

home.heroBody: See which shops around you have it on the shelf right now, what they charge, and how fresh that stock count is. Reserve it and walk in, or let the shop deliver.
home.reserveBanner: Reserve now, pick up in 30 min
home.browseBody: The everyday things that are hard to find online and easy to find nearby.
home.shopsBody: Sorted by distance. The freshness line tells you how recently they counted their shelves.
home.howTitle: Check the shelf before you leave home
home.howBody: Pickup is the default because you get to see it before you pay. Delivery is there when the shop offers it, handled by the shop itself.

search.title: Search the way you talk
search.body: Type 'charging adapter' or 'tap leaking'. NearShop understands meaning, not just exact product names.

reserve.title: Reserve in one tap
reserve.body: The shop confirms and sets it aside for 30 minutes. You get a pickup code and a live countdown.

pay.title: Walk in, check, pay
pay.body: Inspect it at the counter and pay there. If the shop delivers, cash on delivery works too.

owners.title: Your shelf, online by this evening.
owners.body: Pick products from a ready catalogue, set your price and count. Customers nearby find you, reserve, and walk in ready to buy.

alerts.title: Reservation alerts
alerts.body: Confirm or decline with one tap.

forecasts.title: Restock forecasts
forecasts.body: Know what will run out next week.

demand.title: Local demand
demand.body: See what people nearby search for.

trust.title: Earn trust
trust.body: Fresh stock counts rank you higher.

delivery.title: Your delivery, your rules
delivery.body: Set radius, fee and free-delivery limit.

commission.title: No commission to start
commission.body: Pay at the counter, as always.

search.corrected: Showing results for {query}. No matches for “{original}”.
search.matchedAlso: Matched by meaning and keywords, also looked for {terms}
search.noShopsTitle: No shops in this radius yet
search.noShopsBody: Try a wider radius or a different area.
search.nothingBody: Shops nearby don't list this yet. Try a wider radius, fewer filters, or a simpler word.
search.matchingOutOfStock: Has matching items, but they're out of stock

product.goneBody: The shop may have removed it. Search to find it elsewhere nearby.
product.onlyThisShop: Only this shop lists this item right now.
product.boughtTogetherBody: Learned from what customers nearby buy in the same visit. Save a second trip.
product.popularBody: Bestsellers in this category near you.
product.reviewsEmpty: No reviews yet. Reviews come only from completed pickups and deliveries.

product.hintCustomer: Sign in with a customer account to reserve.
product.hintOut: Out of stock here. Compare other shops below.
product.hintPickupOnly: Pickup only. Held {minutes} min after the shop confirms.
product.hintPayAtShop: Pay at the shop. No online payment.
product.trustTitle: Why you can trust this listing

shop.notFoundBody: It may have paused its listing.
